in_marathi.name: Nemaram
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nemaram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nemaram is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a compound of the words 'Nemah' and 'Rama'. Nemah means restless or unquiet, while Rama signifies peace or tranquility. This name is thus a symbol of the inner struggle between restlessness and peace, and the ultimate goal of achieving inner calm.
